_disclaimer: SIMULATED DEMONSTRATION DATA. Fictional, procedurally generated for the BAYOU-NOVA proof of concept (2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge). Not real crew data. Not a medical record. Not for clinical use.
note: Display settings only. Since Phase 5 no status is decided here: the Phase 4 'Monitor when the 7-day mean is more than 2 standard deviations from the early-flight mean' rule was removed because it was an invented magnitude cut-off. Status now comes from shared/detection-rules.json through lib/detection.ts.
own_reference_note: The astronaut's own early-flight days. Shown beside each value for context, and used by the Layer 2 shift comparison. The preflight baseline is still shown as the reference line on every chart.
trailing_note: The 7-day mean is descriptive. It is shown so a single unusual day does not dominate the table; it is not compared with any cut-off.
